name: DDC
text: A header-only C++ library for multidimensional meshes. It provides containers based on C++23 mdspan, geometric iterators and type-safe indexing. Mesh semantics support both generic and specialised algorithms.

name: Deisa
text: Deisa connects MPI simulations with distributed Dask processing. Analysing data during computation reduces transfers and intermediate storage.

name: Kokkos
text: The Kokkos ecosystem supports C++ applications across different hardware architectures using a shared code base. It is a Linux Foundation project and part of the High Performance Software Foundation.

name: PDI
text: PDI decouples applications from data handling libraries. Code annotations and an external specification organise parameter reading, initialisation, post-processing, output, visualisation, fault tolerance, logging, coupling and simulation ensembles.

name: TiledViz
text: A web application for organising and exploring sets of results. Metadata supports sorting and comparison on a workstation or an image wall.

name: YML
text: YML describes parallel applications using the YvetteML workflow language, independently of the underlying environment: grids, peer-to-peer systems or metacomputing.
